stem: A security operations center (SOC) requires a cloud-native solution that collects data across users, devices, applications, and infrastructure across multicloud environments, uses AI to detect threats, and automates incident response workflows using playbooks. Which Microsoft service provides these combined SIEM and SOAR capabilities?
explanation: Microsoft Sentinel is a scalable, cloud-native security information and event management (SIEM) and security orchestration, automated response (SOAR) solution. It collects security data across multicloud and on-premises environments, detects threats using built-in analytics, and automates responses using logic app playbooks. Microsoft Defender for Cloud provides cloud security posture management (CSPM) and workload protection, while Network Watcher provides network monitoring tools.

distractorNotes.b: Microsoft Defender for Cloud focuses on Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP) across multicloud resources rather than unified SIEM log aggregation and correlation.
distractorNotes.c: Azure Network Watcher provides diagnostic and monitoring tools for Azure network infrastructure rather than an enterprise SIEM/SOAR system.
distractorNotes.d: Azure Web Application Firewall provides centralized Layer 7 protection for web applications against common exploits and vulnerabilities rather than log collection and incident orchestration.
